verdict.rationale: Sentry ships AI agent tracing and LLM observability, so routing outputs to human annotation queues is a fair question for it. The evidence only shows viewing, replaying and debugging conversations, LLM calls and traces. Nothing documents annotation queues, human review workflows or labeling. The 'human handoffs' widget tracks agent-to-human transitions at runtime, which is an adjacent feature and not an annotation capability.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can route outputs to human annotation queues for review and labeling
